goal: RC15: Conditional One-Shot Flow Matching. Build a conditional forecasting model on the 152e factored transformer architecture, informed by FMAP (spatial attention + FM) and Lim et al. (data-dependent paths) literature.
scope: Level D — New one-shot FM files + existing encoder. train_oneshot_flow.py, eval scripts, test integration.

constraints.must_generalize: Any conditional scenario generation (IV, rates, FX, credit)
constraints.investigation_blocking: Post-experiment diagnostics REQUIRED per theory_queue diagnostic_plan — EVERY stage
paradigm_requirements: Independent sample trajectories (each ODE starts from independent source)

literature: FMAP (Landry et al., 2504.03463): spatial attention + FM + concatenation conditioning + residual + lead-time scale
Lim et al. (2410.03229, TMLR 2025): data-dependent probability paths for FM forecasting
Lim & Erichson (2602.08318): FM = trajectory replay, nonparametric memory-augmented ODE
FlowCast (2511.09731): CFM in latent space for precipitation
FlowTime (2503.10375): AR flow matching with calibrated uncertainty
Memory-conditioned FM (2602.06689): Mori-Zwanzig proves memoryless closures structurally limited
SFM-NVIDIA (2410.19814): stochastic flow matching for physical super-resolution
BSFM (2603.21717): Bayesian stochastic FM with aleatoric/epistemic decomposition
directions: RC15: H2 (data-dependent source 1h) → H1-S1 (conditional 2h) → H1-S2 (residual 2h) → H1-S3 (per-horizon scale 2h) → H1-S4 (full eval 4h)
